codes.SO_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft order can be changed. A confirmed order is frozen: cancel it and start a new one to change its lines or prices.
codes.SO_NOT_CONFIRMED: Confirm the order first. Only a confirmed order can be invoiced or have its delivery recorded.
codes.SO_CANCELLED: This order is cancelled, so nothing more can be done with it.
codes.SO_QUOTE_NOT_ACCEPTED: Only an accepted proposal or estimate can become a sales order. Mark it as accepted first.
codes.SO_QUOTE_TAKEN: This proposal or estimate already has a sales order.
codes.SO_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS: A quantity is more than what is left on that line. Lower it and try again.
codes.SO_NOTHING_TO_INVOICE: There is nothing left to do here: everything is already invoiced or delivered.
codes.SO_HAS_INVOICES: An invoice made from this order is still live. Void or delete the invoice first, then cancel the order.

list.title: Sales orders
list.subtitle: Accepted offers turned into orders, invoiced in one go or in parts, and delivered.
list.search: Search by number, buyer or reference
list.noAccess: You do not have permission to see sales orders.
list.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches these filters. Change or reset them.

all.title: No sales orders yet
all.message: Turn an accepted proposal or estimate into an order, or start one from scratch.

draft.title: No draft orders
draft.message: Orders you are still preparing show up here.

confirmed.title: No confirmed orders
confirmed.message: Confirmed orders waiting to be invoiced or delivered show up here.

cancelled.title: No cancelled orders
cancelled.message: Orders you cancel show up here with their reason.

closed.title: No closed orders
closed.message: An order closes when everything on it is invoiced and delivered.

actions.invoicedDraft: Draft invoice created from the order.

dialog.qtyExceeds: At most {max} is left on this line.
dialog.qtyInvalid: Enter a quantity with at most 4 decimals, or 0 to skip this line.
dialog.nothingHint: Everything on this order is already invoiced.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm this order?
confirmDialog.message: Confirming freezes the lines and prices. After that you can invoice the order, in one go or in parts, and record deliveries. You can still cancel it while no invoice stands.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this order?
cancelDialog.warning: A cancelled order cannot be invoiced or delivered any more, and it cannot be reopened.
cancelDialog.reasonHint: Kept on the order for your team.
cancelDialog.reasonRequired: Say why the order is cancelled.
cancelDialog.hasInvoices: This order still has an invoice. Void or delete the invoice first (a voided invoice gives its quantities back), then cancel the order.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this draft?
deleteDialog.message: The draft order is removed for good. A confirmed order cannot be deleted, only cancelled.

invoiceDialog.title: Invoice this order
invoiceDialog.intro: Bill the order at its frozen prices. You can invoice it in parts: whatever is not billed now stays on the order.
invoiceDialog.issueNowHint: The invoice gets its number and can be sent right away.
invoiceDialog.draftHint: Leave it as a draft to check it before issuing.

problems.nothing: Choose a quantity above zero on at least one line.
problems.dueBeforeIssue: The due date cannot be before the issue date.

fulfilDialog.title: Record delivery
fulfilDialog.intro: Record what was delivered to the buyer. Delivery is tracked apart from invoicing: either can come first.
fulfilDialog.noteHint: Optional, for example a delivery note number.

problems.nothing: Choose a quantity above zero on at least one line.

detail.noAccess: You do not have permission to see sales orders.
detail.draftHint: This order is a draft. Confirm it to freeze its prices and start invoicing and delivery.

invoices.title: Invoices from this order
invoices.none: No invoice has been made from this order yet.
invoices.noneDraft: Invoices can be made once the order is confirmed.
invoices.voidNote: A voided invoice gives its quantities back to the order.

builder.noAccess: You do not have permission to change sales orders.
builder.frozen: This order is confirmed, so its lines and prices are frozen. Cancel it and start a new one to change them.
builder.conflict: Someone else changed this draft while you were editing. Reload to see their version; your edits here will be lost.
builder.serverRejected: The server did not accept some of the values. Check the fields and try again.
builder.contactHint: Pick a contact to link the order to them, or type the buyer below.
builder.fromQuoteHint: Left empty, the offer's buyer is used.
builder.currencyHint: Three letters, like USD or KWD.
builder.referenceHint: The buyer's purchase order number, for example.
builder.linesFromQuoteHint: The order takes the lines, prices and taxes of the accepted offer, with its document discount folded into the lines. You can still edit the draft's lines after it is created.
builder.termsHint: Carried onto the invoices made from this order.
builder.draftNote: The order stays a draft until you confirm it. Confirming freezes its prices.
builder.quoteTotalsNote: As on the accepted offer. The order's own figures show once it is created.

problems.buyerRequired: Pick a contact or type the buyer's name.

lineProblems.taxRateRemoved: The tax rate of this line no longer exists. Pick a current one.

quotePicker.none: There is no accepted proposal or estimate yet.
